text:
Sara: heads up — after the kernel-selector rollout I see ~7-12% p50 host-side latency increase for streaming. writev spikes.
Raj: flame/trace?
Sara: uploaded flame: https://internal.prod/flames/8012345678. quick: writev calls x3 vs baseline, lots of tiny frames.
Evan: confirmed. gRPC emitting many sub-100B frames. writev/min jumped (~220 -> ~640).
Mike: kernel-selector routed requests to fused-attn path — might change token chunk alignment pre-send.
Sara: KV cache miss rate +15% same window. fragmentation seems to cut token boundaries, more K/V work.
Linda: perf top snapshot (trimmed):
```
SYSCALL  COUNT
writev   12345
sendto     120
read        90
```
Raj: quick mitigations: 1) sidecar coalesce tiny writes (4KB), 2) tune SO_SNDBUF, 3) rollback flag.
Evan: microbench (qps=500 streaming):
- baseline: p50=28.1ms p95=86ms
- regressed: p50=31.0ms p95=103ms
- proxy-coalesce 4KB: p50=28.4ms p95=88ms
Coalesce restores p50 near baseline.
Mike: I'll prototype a sidecar aggregator that buffers small frames until threshold or chunk-end; add metric for small-write-rate.
Sara: repro curl (streaming):
```
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"prompt":"x","stream":true,"max_tokens":200}' https://api.redwood.example/v1/stream/generate
```
Observe many tiny frames.
Linda: also adding perf harness test for pathological token-length distributions (code-heavy single-char tokens).
Raj: long-term: kernel-selector must preserve ingress fragmentation semantics or add re-chunking. Mike/Ryan own invariant.
Mike: opening PR for sidecar coalescing + unit tests; will canary on 5 hosts after review.
deploy-bot: canary deploy started: canary-57 -> prod-us-west (5 hosts).
Evan: after canary p50 returned to ~28.6ms and small-write-rate dropped ~78%. p95 still slightly elevated — investigating KV misses.
Linda: added perf test case: token_lengths=[1,1,1,6,1,1,12] to force fragmentation.
Sara: ACTIONS:
- Mike: PR for sidecar write coalesce (4KB default) + metrics — EOD
- Raj: rollback/toggle plan if canary regresses
- Evan: correlate KV evictions with fragmentation, add telemetry
- Linda: update batch-heuristic tests in harness
:thumbsup:
Mike: starting branch now.
Sara: will monitor canary and post updates here.
